Hi Carlos. How was the verification visit on Monday? Were there any issues?
Yes, Emma. There were two findings. One was minor, and one was critical.
Tell me the critical one first, please.
There was no record of the storage area. The producer did not have the storage documents.
That is a non-compliance with criterion 7. For me, that is the critical finding.
The minor one was a small gap in the training list. Two names were missing.
Good. In the report, please write the criterion, the finding, and the corrective action. I need it by Friday.
Understood, Emma. Thank you for the help.

When I find a problem during a verification visit, I write it in the corrective action plan. First, I write the criterion. Then I write the finding. For example: there was no record of the storage area, or there were two missing documents. After that, I write the severity. A minor issue is a small gap. A critical finding is a serious non-compliance, and it is unacceptable. At the end, I write the corrective action and the date. A good report is short, clear, and honest.

Hi Carlos, this is Emma. Thank you for the visit report. I read your two findings. The missing storage record is a critical non-compliance with criterion seven, and the producer has thirty days for the corrective action. The training gap is a minor issue, so fifteen days is enough. One more thing: in the report, please write the date of the visit next to every finding. Thank you, Carlos. Talk soon.
